items.title: Taibah University - Faculty of Medicine
items.description: Comprehensive engineering solutions including HVAC, firefighting, plumbing, power, lighting, low-current systems, and shop drawing works for Taibah University's Faculty of Medicine.
items.fullDescription: Our consultancy provided comprehensive engineering solutions, including HVAC, firefighting, plumbing, power, lighting, and low-current systems, for Taibah University's Faculty of Medicine. The project, spanning four floors with a total area of 13,000 square meters each, also involved shop drawing works. Our integrated approach ensured safety, efficiency, and sustainability, delivering comfortable indoor conditions, fire safety measures, efficient water management, and reliable power distribution. Adhering to regulations and standards, we tailored high-quality solutions to the facility's specific needs.

Detailed shop drawings ensuring seamless execution across four floors
High-quality engineering solutions customized for a 13,000 sqm medical educational facility

items.title: Manqabad Overpass in Assiut
items.description: Strategic infrastructure project spanning 1,900 meters over the Cairo-Aswan railway, featuring a massive 34-meter, 175-ton steel span installed in record time.
items.fullDescription: The project is being implemented to achieve the targeted plan for Assiut Governorate to solve the problem of railway level crossings, serve the city of Mankabad and its neighboring villages, and eliminate congestion at the city entrance. The total length of the bridge, including ramps and access roads, is 1,900 meters, with a width of 16.70 meters. It passes over the railway lines (Cairo - High Dam) and the watercourse of the Ibrahimia Canal. Arab Contractors Company has completed the installation of the main girders for the final steel span of the Mankabad Overpass project in Assiut Governorate, over the Cairo-Aswan railway lines. This was accomplished in a record time of just three hours, without disrupting train movement and while fully adhering to safety procedures. The steel span is 34 meters long, with a total weight of 175 tons. It was installed using a 400-ton structural crane. This is the last span to be implemented in the project, achieved through collaboration between the Assiut branch, the Central Workshops and Factories Administration, the Equipment Rental Administration, and the Heavy Transport Administration.
features: Total bridge length of 1,900 meters with a width of 16.70 meters
Crosses over the busy Cairo-Aswan railway lines and the Ibrahimia Canal
Successful rapid installation of a 34-meter, 175-ton steel span in just 3 hours
items.mecRole: Engineering supervision of deep foundation piling, concrete and steel quality control, slope verification, and coordination between multiple heavy engineering administrations.

items.title: MEC Partners with the Egyptian Engineers Syndicate to Empower Future Civil Engineers
items.excerpt: We were thrilled to sponsor the employment fair by the Civil Engineering Division of the Egyptian Engineers Syndicate, supporting Egypt's young talent.
items.content:
We at Middle East Engineering Consultants (MEC) were thrilled to be one of the key sponsors of the employment fair organized by the Civil Engineering Division and the Employment Committee of the Egyptian Engineers Syndicate, as part of Civil Engineers' Day celebrations.

The event, attended by Eng. Tarek El-Nabrawy, head of the syndicate, highlighted the importance of continuous learning and skill development for young engineers. MEC received many CVs, offered job vacancies, and distributed valuable giveaways to participants—just the beginning of our commitment to supporting the future of civil engineering in Egypt.

Our CEO Eng. Khaled Abdelgaber, Chairman Prof. Dr. Hesham Diab, and our engineering team were present to ensure direct communication with upper management and young talents.

items.title: MEC Achieves ISO 9001 Certification!
items.excerpt: This significant milestone underscores our unwavering commitment to quality, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement.
items.content:
We are delighted to announce that our engineering consultant office, Middle East Engineering Consultants (MEC), has achieved ISO 9001 certification! ✔

This significant milestone underscores our unwavering commitment to quality, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement. ISO 9001 certification demonstrates our adherence to rigorous quality management standards, ensuring that our clients receive services of the highest caliber. 💯

We extend our sincere appreciation to our dedicated team and valued clients for their support and collaboration in this journey towards excellence.

items.title: First Engineering Employment Forum at Assiut University
items.excerpt: We are proud to continue our journey of success with our participation in the forum, supporting engineers across Egypt.
items.content:
We are proud to continue our journey of success with our participation in the First Engineering Employment Forum at the Faculty of Engineering – Assiut University, under the patronage of Prof. Dr. Ahmed El-Menshawy, President of the University, and in the presence of esteemed academic and engineering leaders.

Middle East Engineering Consultants (MEC) had previously participated in a major employment forum in Cairo last year, and this year in Upper Egypt.

At the forum, we welcomed applications for both job opportunities and internships from talented engineers. A special moment was the recognition of Prof. Dr. Eng. Hesham Diab, who received an award on behalf of our office, in appreciation of our ongoing contribution to the engineering community.

We sincerely thank Assiut University and the organizers for this outstanding event, and we look forward to supporting more engineers across Egypt.

items.title: MEC Serves as Consultant for Manqabad Overpass Bridge Project
items.excerpt: Led by Chairman Prof. Hesham M. Diab, MEC is providing consultancy for the landmark bridge project in Assiut.
items.content:
We are pleased to announce that Middle East Engineering Consultants (MEC), led by our Chairman, Prof. Hesham M. Diab, is serving as the consultant for the Manqabad Overpass Bridge project in Assiut.

A 1,900 meter-long and 16.70-meter-wide bridge spans the Cairo-Aswan railway lines and the Ibrahimia Canal, aiming to alleviate traffic congestion and enhance regional connectivity.

Prof. Diab, a Professor of Concrete Structures at Assiut University, brings extensive expertise in reinforced concrete design to this project.

items.title: CEO Eng. Khaled Abdelgaber Shares Insights on Journey to Excellence
items.excerpt: Eng. Khaled Abdelgaber discussed the triumphs and challenges in our prestigious project, Life Medical Park.
items.content:
Thrilled to share insights from our recent event where Khaled Abdelgaber, our esteemed CEO at Middle East Engineering Consultants (MEC), discussed the challenges and triumphs in our journey towards excellence in engineering consultancy services.

One of those challenges to address was time management challenges faced by our office, particularly in our prestigious project, "Life Medical Park," in collaboration with the visionary owner 3i Pharma S.A.E.

🎥 Take a look at Eng. Abdelgaber's talk on our official LinkedIn page.
